name: phone-input
title: Phone Input
description: A phone number field with a country flag button on the left. Pressing it opens a searchable list of countries showing flags, names and dialling codes; chosen numbers carry the matching flag.
use: You need international numbers where users pick a country and the right dialling code.
avoid: It depends on a country-list package and a popup, so it is heavier than a plain tel field.
a11y: The phone field is named only by its placeholder, and the flag button is labelled just by the flag title. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim bordered field on a dark page, split into a flag button with up-down chevrons and an input reading Enter phone number. The open picker is a rounded panel with a search box above rows of flag, country name and calling code.
behaves: Clicking the flag opens a scrollable country list that filters as you type in its search box. Choosing a country closes the list and swaps the flag and dialling code; typing the number then fills the field.
customise: Pass value, onChange and defaultCountry plus any native input attributes. The flag set, country list and search come from the phone-number package, styled through classes.
weight: moderate: Loads the phone-number library, every country flag and a command palette.
